name: DHL
label: DHL MyDHL + Unified Tracking
description: MyDHL REST express.api.dhl.com/mydhlapi for shipment_create and rate_get (Basic api_key:api_secret; the Express account number goes in the accounts body). tracking_get uses DHL Unified Tracking GET https://api-eu.dhl.com/track/shipments with DHL-API-Key from tracking_api_key (op-level Authorization extraHeader replaces MyDHL Basic on that call). Docs: https://developer.dhl.com/api-reference/shipment-tracking. Shipment create is account-gated.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: tracking_get | shipment_create | rate_get. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. tracking_get is Unified Tracking (not MyDHL). trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: trackingNumber
schema.description: DHL Unified Tracking query trackingNumber (required for tracking_get). Replaces the former MyDHL path param shipmentTrackingNumber.

schema.label: service
schema.description: Unified Tracking query service (express, ecommerce, parcel-de, freight, …). Recommended by DHL; omit only when unknown.

schema.label: originCountryCode
schema.description: Query-string parameter `originCountryCode` for operation: tracking_get.

schema.label: requesterCountryCode
schema.description: Query-string parameter `requesterCountryCode` for operation: tracking_get.

schema.label: recipientPostalCode
schema.description: Unified Tracking query recipientPostalCode for tracking_get.

schema.label: language
schema.description: Unified Tracking language (ISO 639-1) for tracking_get. Example: en.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Unified Tracking pagination offset for tracking_get.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Unified Tracking page size for tracking_get.

schema.label: plannedShippingDateAndTime
schema.description: MyDHL planned ship datetime for shipment_create and rate_get. Example: 2026-10-14T12:00:00 GMT+00:00.

schema.label: productCode
schema.description: MyDHL product code (e.g. P, U, N) for shipment_create and rate_get.

schema.label: localProductCode
schema.description: Optional MyDHL local product code.

schema.label: accounts
schema.description: MyDHL accounts: [{typeCode:shipper, number}]. Required on shipment_create and rate_get.

schema.label: customerDetails
schema.description: MyDHL customerDetails with shipperDetails and receiverDetails (postalAddress + contactInformation). Required on shipment_create and rate_get.

schema.label: content
schema.description: MyDHL shipment content: packages[], isCustomsDeclarable, description, incoterm, unitOfMeasurement. Required on shipment_create.

schema.label: pickup
schema.description: MyDHL pickup block, e.g. {"isRequested":false}. shipment_create.

schema.label: valueAddedServices
schema.description: MyDHL VAS codes for shipment_create / rate_get.

schema.label: outputImageProperties
schema.description: MyDHL label image options for shipment_create (printerDPI, encodingFormat, imageOptions).

schema.label: customerReferences
schema.description: MyDHL customerReferences for shipment_create.

schema.label: getRateEstimates
schema.description: When true, shipment_create also returns rate estimates.

schema.label: estimatedDeliveryDate
schema.description: MyDHL estimatedDeliveryDate request block for shipment_create.

schema.label: unitOfMeasurement
schema.description: rate_get unit: metric | imperial.

schema.label: packages
schema.description: rate_get packages [{weight, dimensions}]. Official packages array.

schema.label: isCustomsDeclarable
schema.description: rate_get customs flag.

schema.label: nextBusinessDay
schema.description: rate_get nextBusinessDay.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: tracking_get | shipment_create | rate_get. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: MyDHL API key issued on the DHL Developer Portal app (shipment_create / rate_get). Sent as the Basic auth username (api_key:api_secret). Example: demo-key-placeholder. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Api Secret
configurationParameters.description: MyDHL API secret paired with api_key on the DHL Developer Portal app. Sent as the Basic auth password (api_key:api_secret) for shipment_create / rate_get. Example: demo-secret-placeholder. The DHL Express account number is NOT an auth value; pass it in the accounts body list ([{"typeCode":"shipper","number":"123456789"}]). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Tracking Api Key
configurationParameters.description: DHL Developer Portal consumer key for Unified Tracking. Sent as DHL-API-Key (and as op-level Authorization override so MyDHL Basic is not used on tracking_get). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Recipientpostalcode
configurationParameters.description: Unified Tracking query recipientPostalCode for tracking_get.

configurationParameters.label: Limit
configurationParameters.description: Unified Tracking page size for tracking_get.

configurationParameters.label: Offset
configurationParameters.description: Unified Tracking pagination offset for tracking_get.

configurationParameters.label: Requestercountrycode
configurationParameters.description: Query-string parameter `requesterCountryCode` for operation: tracking_get.

configurationParameters.label: Language
configurationParameters.description: Unified Tracking language (ISO 639-1) for tracking_get. Example: en.

configurationParameters.label: Origincountrycode

configurationParameters.label: Service

configurationParameters.label: Trackingnumber

configurationParameters.label: Customerdetails

configurationParameters.label: Productcode

configurationParameters.label: Outputimageproperties

configurationParameters.label: Customerreferences

configurationParameters.label: Estimateddeliverydate

configurationParameters.label: Accounts
configurationParameters.description: MyDHL accounts: [{typeCode:shipper, number}]. Required on shipment_create and rate_get.

configurationParameters.label: Pickup
configurationParameters.description: MyDHL pickup block, e.g. {"isRequested":false}. shipment_create.

configurationParameters.label: Localproductcode
configurationParameters.description: Optional MyDHL local product code.

configurationParameters.label: Iscustomsdeclarable
configurationParameters.description: rate_get customs flag.

configurationParameters.label: Packages
